name: FNB
verdict: FNB is a division of FirstRand Bank Limited, wholly owned by JSE-listed FirstRand Limited; the Public Investment Corporation, an asset manager wholly owned by the South African government, holds 15.7% of FirstRand.
note: Front-of-shirt sponsor of the Springboks since the March 2025 announcement (first worn vs Italy, 5 July 2025); the gold FNB logo sits centre chest on the 2026/27 home jersey. Rating note: on hold for a maintainer. Proposed concern: the Public Investment Corporation (PIC), wholly owned by the South African government, holds 15.7% of FirstRand (firstrand-pic-stake, pic-government-ownership) - over the 5% threshold - and South Africa's record is documented (south-africa-marikana-killings: police killed 34 striking miners at Marikana in 2012). The stake is a portfolio holding without control. First set to none in the rating sweep before the PIC stake was known; reset to unrated after the review flagged the state fund in the chain (issue #727).
